extDescription.message: Real-time video upscaling with AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 1, on any graphics card.

cmdToggleInfo.message: Show/hide resolution and fps on the video

cmdToggleCompare.message: A/B comparison: bilinear on the left, upscaler on the right

popupNeedsAccess.message: Access to sites is needed to find videos.

statusTransform.message: Video rotated or scaled with CSS: not supported

statusFullscreenVideo.message: Fullscreen of the video element alone: not supported

statusNotNeeded.message: Not needed: the video is already as large as the player (×$SCALE$)

statusBudget.message: Too many active videos on the page

statusCrossOrigin.message: Video from another domain without CORS: cannot be read

statusGpuSlow.message: Graphics card too slow for this video

optionsSitesHelp.message: One site per line. Subdomains are included: youtube.com also covers m.youtube.com. You can also change them from the popup, with the site switch.

optionsMinScaleHelp.message: Below the threshold the original video is shown, at no GPU cost.

optionsMinScale200.message: ×2: only videos much smaller than the screen

optionsShortcutsHint.message: To change them: about:addons → gear icon → Manage Extension Shortcuts.

optionsResetConfirm.message: Restore all settings, including the site lists?

onboardingIntro.message: This extension makes playing videos sharper with AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 1, right on your graphics card. To find the videos on web pages it needs access to the sites you visit. It does not collect or send any data.

onboardingGranted.message: Access granted. Reload tabs with open videos: upscaling starts automatically.

onboardingDenied.message: Permission denied: without access to sites the extension cannot see the videos.

onboardingDrm.message: DRM-protected videos (Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+…) cannot be processed.
